title: 第十三章 关于能力变种开发的理论与实践第十四章 极道美学一拳超人
content_zh:
林夜：“？？？”
什么鬼？
这家伙已经这么病态了吗？
他们只是被治安署喊去问话，就成了他的目标？
“喂，老林，你在听吗？”
电话里再次传来张郃急促的声音，林夜恢复思绪，轻声回应。
“我在。”
“你在听就好，抓紧回学校，咱们学校的安保还是很严格的，那小子应该不敢擅自闯进去。”
“那你呢？”
“我家宝宝已经为我请了专业的保镖，都是退伍特种兵，你不用担心。”
宝宝...
林夜的脸蛋忍不住狠狠抽搐了一下。
“行，就这样说了，我宝宝还在等我呢，等那狗养的落网了，我请你去happy。”
电话挂断，传来阵阵嘟嘟声。
林夜收起手机，眉头却有些紧锁。
黄海现在有可能是进化者，实力远超一般人，虽然他的目标很多，可毕竟自己也在其中，鬼知道他什么时候会钻出来对自己出手？
这种被毒蛇在暗中盯着的感觉，总归是让人有些不爽的。
另外，他从觉醒进化以来，还没有碰到过一个真正的进化者，他也想远距离观测一下，看看其他进化者到底和自己有什么不同？实力在什么程度？
这有利于他对自身在周遭环境中的实力进行一个评判。
“要不，回去用公共网络查一下这小子的位置？”

但林夜很快便否定了这个想法。
联邦里面的能人不少，他们肯定早就已经查过了，黄海也不至于傻到不去避开那些摄像头。
这个方法肯定不可行。
“我该用什么办法呢？”
林夜的视线看向远处，几只小麻雀正在彼此追逐嬉戏，恍惚片刻，林夜的嘴角微微扬起。
“这不就是现成的探子？”
还有什么比这个城市里的小麻雀更适合打探消息的呢？
它们可以肆意飞行到每一个角落，而且因为是麻雀，也不会引起任何人的注意和警觉。
...
十分钟后，林夜一手拿着手机，一手给小麻雀喂着面包屑。
“看到这个人了吗？找到他，你们就可以得到更多的面包。”
“叽叽（明白了）。”
大部分小麻雀们立刻四散飞离，唯独两只胖乎乎的小馋虫，还在地上找着残存的面包屑。
林夜看向这两只小麻雀，陷入了微微的沉思。
随着脑力的不断进化提升，他的思维也比以前多了许多新想法。
“精神沟通，不应该只是和其他生物进行沟通，应该还有一些别的使用方法。”
第一点，是否能通过契合对方的脑电波，对对方进行记忆查询？
这一点就像是自己刚刚学到的黑客技术。
每一个生物的脑子都像是一个独立的cpu，通过不同频率波动渗透其中，就像黑客潜入别人的网站。
这样想着，林夜立刻开始尝试驱动。

小麻雀的脑容量很小，就像那些小公司的水准，所以很容易搞定。
原本正在贪吃的小麻雀，忽然间停止了动作，站在原地呆滞地一动不动。
而林夜则是感觉自己的脑海里仿佛在放幻灯片一样，播放着各种画面，那些都是在小麻雀脑海里存在的记忆片段。
content_en:
Lin Ye: "???"
What the hell?
Is this guy already so sick?
They were just called for questioning by the Public Security Department, and they became his targets?
"Hey, Lao Lin, are you listening?"
Zhang He's urgent voice came again on the phone. Lin Ye regained his thoughts and responded softly.
"I'm here."
"As long as you're listening, go back to school as soon as possible. Our school's security is still very strict. That kid shouldn't dare to break in without permission."
"What about you?"
"My baby has hired professional bodyguards for me. They are all retired special forces. You don't have to worry."
baby...
Lin Ye's face couldn't help but twitch violently.
"Okay, let's just say it. My baby is still waiting for me. When that bastard is caught, I'll ask you to go and be happy."
The phone was hung up and there was a series of beeps.
Lin Ye put away his phone, but his brows were furrowed.
Huang Hai might be an evolver now, and his strength far exceeds that of ordinary people. Although he has many targets, after all, he is among them. Who knows when he will come out and take action against him?
This feeling of being watched in the dark by a poisonous snake is always a bit unpleasant.
In addition, he has not met a real evolver since his awakening and evolution. He also wants to observe it from a distance to see how other evolvers are different from himself. To what extent is the strength?
This helps him evaluate his own strength in the surrounding environment.
"How about we go back and use the public network to check this guy's location?"
But Lin Ye quickly rejected this idea.
There are many capable people in the federation. They must have checked it long ago, and Huang Hai is not stupid enough not to avoid those cameras.
This method is definitely not feasible.
"What should I do?"
Lin Ye looked into the distance, where several small sparrows were chasing and playing with each other. After a moment of trance, the corners of Lin Ye's mouth raised slightly.
"Isn't this a ready-made spy?"
What better person to pry for information than the little sparrows in this city?
They can fly to every corner, and because they are sparrows, they will not attract anyone's attention or alertness.
...
Ten minutes later, Lin Ye was holding the mobile phone in one hand and feeding the little sparrow crumbs with the other.
"See this man? Find him and you will get more bread."
"Jiji (I understand)."
Most of the little sparrows immediately flew away, except for two chubby little gluttons, still looking for the remaining bread crumbs on the ground.
Lin Ye looked at the two little sparrows and fell into slight thought.
As his brain power continues to evolve and improve, his thinking has many more new ideas than before.
"Spiritual communication should not only be used to communicate with other creatures, but there should be other ways to use it."
The first point is, is it possible to query the other person's memory by matching the other person's brain waves?
This is like the hacking technique I just learned.
The brain of every living thing is like an independent CPU, which penetrates through different frequency fluctuations, just like a hacker sneaking into other people's websites.
Thinking like this, Lin Ye immediately started trying to drive.
The little sparrow's brain capacity is very small, just like those of small companies, so it is easy to handle.
The little sparrow that was eating greedily suddenly stopped moving and stood motionless.
Lin Ye felt as if a slideshow was playing in his mind, playing various scenes, which were all fragments of memories that existed in the little sparrow's mind.
